Nomadic Clan

Some Fenari simply never settle down, preferring to keep roaming from place to place in search of new treasures to discover. These Fenari never develop traits or ideals from another people, but it leaves them wonderfully adaptable. They set up camp near or inside settlements to peddle their wares and any interesting things they've snatched up, and perform and entertain in exchange for whatever supplies they need.

Nomadic Fenari are the most likely to uphold the Fenari Creed, and the quickest to punish (and even shun) those who break it.

Alignment. Nomadic Fenari aren't swayed by other peoples, and their Creed pulls them toward lawful alignments.

Fenari Traits

  • Size. Fenari grow between 4'0" and 5'2" tall and weigh 70 to 120 pounds. Your size is Small or Medium (choose when you select this species).
  • Creature Type. Humanoid
  • Speed. 30 feet
  • Darkvision. You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet of you as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
  • Enhanced Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
  • Bite. Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can use to make Unarmed Strikes, dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit.
  • Languages. Common and one other language of your choice.
  • Nomadic Skill. You gain proficiency in two of: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Performance, Survival, Cartographer's Tools, Leatherworker's Tools, Weaver's Tools, Woodcarver's Tools, or one musical instrument.

See the The Fenari journal for the Fenari's history, Creed, and appearance.
